summary: Crash when setting LodestonePos of compass to something other than NBT compound
description: The bug The game crashes when changing or creating a compass item with a LodestonePos having a value other than an NBT compound tag. [ (20w17a) crash-2020-04-23_21.44.55-server.txt] Description: Ticking player java.lang.ClassCastException: lp cannot be cast to la at bhr.a(SourceFile:144) at bje.a(SourceFile:454) at bcw.j(SourceFile:290) at bcx.l(SourceFile:575) at anz.h(SourceFile:2217) at bcx.h(SourceFile:274) at ys.i(SourceFile:411) at zj.b(SourceFile:199) at ma.a(SourceFile:234) at zi.c(SourceFile:171) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.b(SourceFile:839) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.a(SourceFile:766) at enn.a(SourceFile:89) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.run(SourceFile:625) at java.lang.Thread.run(Thread.java:745) How to reproduce Do this in a test world give s compass{LodestoneDimension:"minecraft:overworld",LodestonePos:"This is not an NBT compound"} The game freezes and you will see in the log file that it has crashed
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft.
2. Create a new test world.
3. Open the chat and enter the command: `/give @p compass{LodestoneDimension:"minecraft:overworld",LodestonePos:"This is not an NBT compound"}`.
4. Wait for the game to process the command.
5. Observe that the game freezes and then crashes, as indicated in the log file.
Observed Behavior:
When attempting to create or modify a compass item with an invalid `LodestonePos` value that is not formatted as a valid NBT compound, the game crashes with a `ClassCastException`. Specifically, if the `LodestonePos` is provided as a string or any other non-compound format, the game fails to process the item correctly during the player's tick update, leading to a crash.

The error is logged as follows:

This behavior can be replicated consistently by executing the command:

```
/give @p compass{LodestoneDimension:"minecraft:overworld",LodestonePos:"This is not an NBT compound"}
```

Upon executing this command, the game freezes and subsequently crashes, as indicated in the crash report file. The expected behavior is for the game to either handle invalid inputs gracefully or to provide a clear error message rather than crashing.
Expected Behavior: When setting the LodestonePos of a compass to a valid NBT compound tag, the game should successfully create or modify the compass item without any crashes or errors. The LodestonePos should be recognized and processed correctly, allowing players to utilize the compass as intended. This behavior should remain consistent across all versions of the game, ensuring a stable experience when using compass items with valid data.
